about: Graph trigger names and whether the host's name rule admits them, and the message that states the rule. AI-WS-SDK spec/engine-v1/GRAPH-WORKFLOWS.md, "Names", gives a graph trigger name the template name rule with the name check refused too. The rule binds only a trigger with a Starts target. The Rust rule and the builder's copy are both tested against these.
rule: A graph trigger name is a lowercase letter, then at most 62 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and isn't check or a Windows device name such as con, nul, com1 or lpt1. The Praxis host refuses any other name.
